cases.sentence: Когда Санбалат услышал о том, что мы строим стену, он разозлился и сильно разгневался против ___.
cases.translation: When Sanballat heard that we were rebuilding the wall, he was furious with the Jews.
cases.explain: The preposition "против" (against) requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Да что они там строят, если даже лисица, взобравшись на эту каменную стену, обрушит ее? из этих груд ___.
cases.translation: Will they revive the stones out of these heaps of dust?
cases.explain: The partitive genitive indicates the material from which something is taken.

cases.sentence: Услышь нас, ___ наш, потому что мы в презрении.
cases.translation: Hear us, O God, for we are despised.
cases.explain: The vocative "Боже" is used when addressing God directly.

cases.sentence: И мы строили стену, и она достигла половины своей высоты, потому что народ работал от всего ___.
cases.translation: The wall was completed to half its height because the people worked with all their heart.
cases.explain: The genitive expression "от всего сердца" means "with all one's heart".
Prayer directed to someone requires the dative case.

cases.sentence: Я разместил народ за самыми низкими участками стены, поставив их по семьям с мечами, копьями и ___.
cases.translation: I positioned the people at the lowest parts of the wall, by families with swords, spears, and bows.
cases.explain: Items in a series with similar constructions share the same case: instrumental for "with".

cases.sentence: Не бойтесь их, помните владыку, который велик и грозен, и сражайтесь за своих братьев, сыновей, дочерей, жен и ___.
cases.translation: Do not be afraid of them; remember the Lord who is great and awesome, and fight for your brothers, your sons, your daughters, your wives, and your homes.
cases.explain: Direct objects in a series require the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Где бы вы не услышали звук рога, бегите к нам туда, откуда доносится звук, наш ___ будет сражаться за нас.
cases.translation: Our God will fight for us.
cases.explain: The subject of the verb "будет сражаться" requires the nominative case.

reading.question: What is the main topic of this section?
reading.explain: This section is titled "Противодействие строительству стены" (Opposition to wall building).

reading.ru: Когда Санбалат услышал о том, что мы строим стену, он разозлился и сильно разгневался.
reading.question: How did Sanballat react to hearing about the wall being built?
options: He was furious and very angry
reading.correct: He was furious and very angry
reading.explain: Upon hearing about the wall construction, Sanballat became very angry and frustrated.

reading.ru: Да что они там строят, если даже лисица, взобравшись на эту каменную стену, обрушит ее?
reading.question: What did Tobiah say about the wall being built?
options: It was strong and would last
Even a fox climbing it would break it down
reading.correct: Even a fox climbing it would break it down
reading.explain: Tobiah mocked the wall, saying even a fox could break through it.

reading.ru: И мы строили стену, и она достигла половины своей высоты, потому что народ работал от всего сердца.
reading.question: How much of the wall was built and why?
options: The whole wall because they were forced
Half the height because the people worked wholeheartedly
A small part because they were tired
reading.correct: Half the height because the people worked wholeheartedly
reading.explain: The wall reached half its height because the people worked with all their heart.

reading.ru: Но мы молились нашему Богу и выставляли против них стражу днем и ночью, чтобы отвратить эту угрозу.
reading.question: What did the people do in response to the threat?
options: They prayed to God and posted guards day and night
reading.correct: They prayed to God and posted guards day and night
reading.explain: In response to the threat, the people prayed and maintained guards continuously.

reading.ru: И каждый из строителей во время работы был припоясан мечом, а трубач находился рядом со мной.
reading.question: How were the builders prepared while working?
options: Each builder wore a sword and a trumpeter was with Nehemiah
reading.correct: Each builder wore a sword and a trumpeter was with Nehemiah
reading.explain: The builders worked armed with swords, and a trumpeter stayed near Nehemiah to sound alarms.
